description: This Java source file defines an abstract class 'GenericMapSet' which extends 'GenericMapCollection' and implements 'Set'. It provides custom implementations for 'equals' and 'hashCode' methods, and handles generic types for keys, values, and internal map structure.

classes.name: GenericMapSet
classes.description: An abstract class representing a Set backed by a Map, with custom equality and hash code implementations.
